node: Data-center power, thermal, and balance-of-plant infrastructure
summary: Expanded the node around AI data-center electrical and thermal balance-of-plant. Reference lane is anchored by Vertiv as the high-attention pure-play leader in power, thermal, modular infrastructure and services. Underfollowed lane highlights smaller or less obvious industrial suppliers that screen as electrical equipment, thermal management, or construction-input names rather than AI companies: Powell Industries for custom power-control and distribution systems, Modine for data-center cooling and liquid-cooling capacity expansion, and Atkore for conduit, cable-management, raceway and infrastructure products used in data-center electrical buildouts. This is not a recommendation list; it is a Layer 1B research universe with explicit evidence gaps for later verification.
